name: Uchuujin no Onna no Ko Bokujou
source:
In the past, humans conquered the Earth. That much is certain. But...

Masaki is the livestock of Chikyuu Ranch, the Oskyuu. He is a rare type of Gyuu, differing from the other breeders. One day, when he awoke, he found himself in an unfamiliar cage. Beyond the cage are the aliens who control the ranch! The Crimson Princess, the Princess's chamberlain, a boy who looks like a girl, and a slime who looks more like a girl?

For some reason, Masaki also had memories of being the only “Earthling” in Gyuu’s mind. On top of that, he was also a severe sci-fi otaku! A heterogeneous harem world, the dream of a heterochromatic sex maniac?!
translation:
过去，人类征服了地球。这一点毋庸置疑。但是……

正树是地球牧场“奥斯丘”的牲畜。他属于稀有的“牛”类型，与其他饲养品种不同。某天醒来时，他发现自己身处陌生的笼子。笼子外是控制牧场的外星人！赤红公主、公主的侍从、外表像女孩的男孩，以及一个更像女孩的史莱姆？

不知为何，正树还保留着身为“牛族”唯一“地球人”的记忆。而且，他还是一名重度科幻宅！这是一个异质后宫世界，是异色瞳性狂的梦想吗？！
